content: Human-labeling session — combat-harass-aggro-commit:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is an aggressive raid against an enemy economy. You are given 3 medium tanks staged in the north corridor (y=10..14) or the south corridor (y=26..30) depending on seed. An enemy Ore Refinery sits at (40,20) with 4 harvesters working the patch and TWO heavy tanks on guard — one north at (36,16), one south at (36,24). Each heavy out-trades a medium tank one-on-one. Focus all three of your tanks on ONE guard at a time, then the second, then sweep the four harvesters. Splitting fire across both heavies lets them grind you down. Six kills, one raider surviving, within about 95 turns.
